text:
incident-bot: PAGED: metering anomaly detected — rotational count skew across emitter pool (eu-west). token delta spike 02:12-03:05 UTC, >18% vs baseline. alert id: MTR-2026-03-18-01

sam (oncall): I'm on it. paging ben + lily. taking triage channel.

ben (infra): seeing repeated ack/retry patterns from proxy-emitter-03 and proxy-emitter-07. logs show identical event_ids re-ingested across partitions. suspect emitter partition handoff bug. sample:
```
[2026-03-18T02:13:12Z] emitter=proxy-emitter-03 part=7 event_id=evt_9f2a seq=184572 delta_tokens=+12000
[2026-03-18T02:13:13Z] emitter=proxy-emitter-07 part=3 event_id=evt_9f2a seq=184572 delta_tokens=+12000
```

lily (sre): confirmed counts doubled for partition group {3,7}. shadow_agg monotonic window shows duplicate adds.

claudia (billing): customers receiving early overage flags? Anyone have count of affected customers?

ben (infra): quick estimate from sample: ~110 customers had write events in the window. some are flagged by billing pipeline due to burst thresholds.

sam (oncall): mitigation plan: 1) disable emitter pool auto-retry on proxy-emitter-07 (temp) 2) silence overage-alert channel for inferred duplicates 3) start a one-off reconciliation job to dedupe events in ingestion staging 4) notify CS for customer comms if backfill changes bills.

ops-bot: action_taken: set config proxy-emitter-07.retries=0 by sam at 1755555561

ben (infra): applied proxy toggle, observed reduced duplicate ingress within 45s.

sam (oncall): silenced billing.overages alerts (scope=eu-west, reason="inferred duplicate inbound") — will revert after recon.

claudia (billing): running quick SQL to find flagged invoices in window. rough query:
```
SELECT customer_id, count(*) as hit_count
FROM billing.alerts
WHERE alert_type='overage' AND ts >= '2026-03-18T02:00:00Z' AND ts <= '2026-03-18T03:30:00Z'
GROUP BY customer_id
ORDER BY hit_count DESC
LIMIT 200;
```

claudia (billing): initial run: 123 unique customers with at least one overage flag. adding to incident list. estimated delta exposure: ~+2-4% token counts for affected customers pending dedupe.

lily (sre): starting recon job now: `./tools/recon_dedupe --src=staging --window=2026-03-18T02:00:00Z,2026-03-18T03:30:00Z --mode=preview` — will report counts then run real.

ben (infra): note — root cause looks like race in emitter partition handoff when proxy-emitter-07 rejoined after transient, it replayed last acked batch without de-dup key. patch drafted: add idempotency key check in emitter ACK path.

sam (oncall): customer comms: tag for CS: Claudia, can you draft short note: "We observed transient duplicate metering events in EU region; affected usage will be deduped and bills adjusted if necessary. No lasting data loss."

claudia (billing): on it. drafting now and will share.

ops-bot: recon preview completed at 1755555622: preview_dedupe_matches=1849 potential duplicate events, projected customer impact minimal after dedupe.

lily (sre): running real dedupe job: `./tools/recon_dedupe --mode=apply` — ETA ~12m. monitoring CPU on staging and rate on ingestion.

ben (infra): deploying hotfix to emitter ACK path to prevent future replays. rolling to canary (proxy-emitter-07) now.

sam (oncall): handover notes for next oncall (lily):
- root cause: emitter partition handoff replayed events -> duplicated tokens
- mitigation done: retries disabled on emitter-07, dedupe applied to staging, billing alerts silenced and will be re-enabled after verification
- customer impact: 123 alerted, estimated +2-4% token counts, most will be cleaned; CS notified for outreach if adjustments > $50
- follow-ups: monitor reconciliation metrics, watch billing pipeline for re-emit of cleaned events, ensure patch passes canary then roll full.

lily (sre): taking next shift. will watch until recon job completes and billing alerts re-enabled. will follow up with post-incident summary. :thumbsup:

claudia (billing): posted CS notice draft to #customer-comm-drafts and added list of affected customers.

sam (oncall): thanks team — leaving the channel at 1755555659, passing pager to lily.

incident-bot: STATUS CHANGE: incident MTR-2026-03-18-01 -> mitigated (dedupe applied, duplicate ingress curtailed). monitor window open for 2 hours.
